##### Project general facts

The Bank by OXO is a gated residential community developed by Nestate Spaces Indonesia in collaboration with OXO Group, blending European design standards with local soul. This exclusive enclave features highly crafted villas and apartments designed for long-term living. With a private looping road, gated entrance, and 24/7 security, the development offers a safe, walkable environment where families can thrive amidst nature. 

Residents enjoy access to a clubhouse featuring a high-end gym, Finnish sauna, communal pool, lounge with billiards, co-working spaces, open kitchen and bar, and a children's play area. A riverside deck provides lounge seating for quiet reflection, while the private road encourages movement and connection. Smart home integration, energy-efficient construction, on-demand concierge, and turn-key management services ensure effortless living and seamless rental income potential.

Every villa boasts high-end furniture, refined finishes, and quality accessories, blending function and elegance with a tropical touch. Open-plan layouts with generous openings allow natural light and air to flow abundantly. Premium mattresses and top-quality bedding ensure deep, restorative sleep. Kitchens feature top-tier appliances and thoughtful design, while private pools, sunlit terraces, and in-house saunas deliver everyday luxury in a serene riverside setting.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Pererenan, one of Bali's most sought-after enclaves, this exceptional location offers an idyllic and stylish beachside village that balances sophistication and calm with a growing creative energy. Here, rice fields meet rooftop bars, surf culture blends with slow living, and the pace feels just right. As the area continues to evolve, it retains its laid-back charm while welcoming a new wave of conscious, design-minded residents.

Tucked just off Pererenan's main road in a quiet lane, the development is set back from the bustle, close enough to enjoy the area's stylish energy, yet perfectly positioned for privacy and ease. Located along Bali's sought-after southwest coast, this dynamic region is the heart of the island's creative and social scene, where beaches, culture, and contemporary lifestyle converge. Just a short drive from central Canggu and the airport, the area offers effortless access to world-class dining, surfing, and entertainment.

For those seeking a residence that embodies riverside tranquility and urban connectivity, Pererenan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, growing sophistication, and strong community spirit makes it one of Bali's most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, serene, stylish and effortlessly connected.
